Dear Mr. Wallcroft,
Our board of directors asked me to convey their compliments on your beautifully
handcrafted fountain pens. Company President Asa Nakaima, who commissioned
he pens to honor our board members, said your work surpassed his expectations
Most noteworthy was how you inscribed the initials of a different board member o
each pen. Consequently, every writing implement is a personalized work of art to
be cherished.
Mr. Nakaima is also grateful that our company's vice president, Chihiro Hirota,
came up with the idea to have you create these gifts, which were distributed at the
board's most recent meeting.
Best regards,
Gwen Reger

Nakaima Industries
